title: AFP Chief Calls for One Visayas Command Under New Commander
intro_html: The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) welcomed Major General Moises Micor PAF as the new Commander of the Visayas Command (VISCOM) during a change of command ceremony held on October 5 at Camp Lapu-Lapu, Cebu City. AFP Chief of Staff General Antonio G. Nafarrete presided over the ceremony.
image_caption: AFP Chief of Staff General Antonio G. Nafarrete engages with senior officers of the Visayas Command (VISCOM) prior to the change of command ceremony held on October 5 at Camp Lapu-Lapu, Cebu City.
body_html:
CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) welcomed Major General Moises Micor PAF as the new Commander of the Visayas Command (VISCOM) during a change of command ceremony held on October 5 at Camp Lapu-Lapu, Cebu City. AFP Chief of Staff General Antonio G. Nafarrete presided over the ceremony.

During the ceremony, General Nafarrete recognized Major General Peter Burgonio for his service as VISCOM Commander in an acting capacity while concurrently serving as Commander of Joint Task Force STORM and the Philippine Army’s 8th Infantry Division. The Chief of Staff commended Major General Burgonio for his leadership and continued commitment to the AFP’s mission in the region.

A member of the Philippine Military Academy “Maalab” Class of 1993, Major General Micor brings extensive command experience from the Philippine Air Force. Before assuming as VISCOM Commander, he served as Commander of the Air Mobility Command and previously led the Tactical Operations Wing Central and the 205th Tactical Helicopter Wing.

The AFP Chief called on VISCOM under the new leadership of Major General Micor to remain prepared for the full range of missions that may be required of the command. “VISCOM must remain ready for the other missions that may be required of it. Continue to work as one Visayas Command,” he said, underscoring the importance of unity, readiness, and sustained service to the Filipino people.

Photos by PFC Carmelotes PN(M) / PAOAFP
